q: How many packs built on line 1 in April 2026 currently contain cells from supplier 5?
gold:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.pack_sn) AS packs
FROM pk_bld p JOIN dim_ln l ON l.ln_id = p.ln_id JOIN dim_site si ON si.site_id = l.site_id
JOIN gnl_lnk pm ON pm.parent_sn = p.pack_sn AND pm.child_lvl = 'MOD' AND pm.vld_to IS NULL
JOIN gnl_lnk cm ON cm.parent_sn = pm.child_sn AND cm.child_lvl = 'CELL' AND cm.vld_to IS NULL
JOIN cel_mst c ON c.cell_sn = cm.child_sn JOIN dim_lot lt ON lt.lot_id = c.lot_id
WHERE p.ln_id = 1 AND lt.supp_id = 5 AND (p.bld_ts_utc + to_hours(CAST(si.utc_ofst_h AS BIGINT))) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' AND (p.bld_ts_utc + to_hours(CAST(si.utc_ofst_h AS BIGINT))) < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
naive:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.pack_sn) AS packs
FROM pk_bld p JOIN dim_ln l ON l.ln_id = p.ln_id JOIN dim_site si ON si.site_id = l.site_id
JOIN gnl_lnk pm ON pm.parent_sn = p.pack_sn AND pm.child_lvl = 'MOD'
JOIN gnl_lnk cm ON cm.parent_sn = pm.child_sn AND cm.child_lvl = 'CELL'
JOIN cel_mst c ON c.cell_sn = cm.child_sn JOIN dim_lot lt ON lt.lot_id = c.lot_id
WHERE p.ln_id = 1 AND lt.supp_id = 5 AND p.bld_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' AND p.bld_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'

naive: SELECT COUNT(*) AS scrapped_packs FROM scrp_evt s WHERE s.ln_id = 3 AND s.scrp_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' AND s.scrp_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'

q: Using the daily scrap summary, what was the total scrap count on line 5 for May 2026?
gold: SELECT SUM(scrp_cnt) AS scrapped_packs FROM agg_scrp_dly WHERE ln_id = 5 AND dt_lcl >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND dt_lcl < DATE '2026-06-01'
naive: SELECT SUM(scrp_cnt) AS scrapped_packs FROM scrp_dly_snap WHERE ln_id = 5 AND dt >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND dt < DATE '2026-06-01'
